programme.title: David Gilmour - Remember That Night
programme.desc: David Gilmour - Remember That Night: Live at the Royal Albert Hall is recorded by guitarist David Gilmour where he presents live tracks from the album On an Island and some hits from his former band Pink Floyd.

programme.title: Lana Del Rey - Live in London 2012
programme.desc: Born to Die is the second album by singer-songwriter Lana Del Rey, and the first to be officially released on January 27, 2012 and that would lead to global success; In countries such as the United Kingdom the album was the best selling of that year, that recognition made her a guest of honor in one of the most popular London festivals iTunes Festival, where she would open the awe of all attendees on the night of September 25 2012 at the Roundhouse in the city of London.

programme.title: Usher - Omg Tour (Live from London)
programme.desc: Treating the crowd at London's O2 Arena to his signature brand of R;B infused pop, Usher performed hits from recent albums Versus and Raymond V. Raymond, including DJ Got Us Falling in Love, There Goes My Baby, and OMG,.

programme.title: Jerry Lee Lewis - Jerry Lee Lewis and Friends
programme.desc: Jerry Lee Lewis is one of the founding fathers of Rock n Roll. He was one of the original Sun Records quartet along with Elvis Presley, Carl Perkins and Johnny Cash who between them defined the music of a generation. His recording career has stretched from the mid-50s to the present day and his unique style of piano playing has influenced scores of musicians over the years.

programme.title: George Michael - Live in London
programme.desc: George Michael termine sa tournée 25 Live avec son tout premier film de concert, où l'ancien leader de Wham! revisite des hits familiers ou récents au cours de deux spectacles à guichets fermés à Earls Court à Londres.

programme.title: Florence And The Machine - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Yes - Songs From Tsongas 35th Anniversary
programme.desc: Songs From Tsongas is a live performance from Yes' 35th Anniversary Tour in 2004, the last tour by the band to feature the classic line-up of Jon Anderson, Steve Howe, Chris Squire, Rick Wakeman and Alan White.

programme.title: Alabama Shakes - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: Mixing classic RAndB vocals with a soulful blues-rock base, Alabama Shakes have taken garage rock and turned it on its head. Alabama Shakes takes the Austin City Limits stage for the second time in support of their newest album Sound And Color.

programme.title: John Mayall - 70th Birthday Concert
programme.desc: Liverpools Kings Dock on July 19 2003 was the venue for a long awaited and much anticipated reunion between Eric Clapton and John Mayall And the Bluesbreakers. The occasion was both a celebration of John Mayalls 70th year and a fundraiser for Unicef. Also invited to the party were former Bluesbreaker and Rolling Stone Mick Taylor and veteran trombonist Chris Barber. If youre a lover of the blues it doesnt get much better than this. The show ran for around two and a half hours and the film is now presented here in its entirety for the first time.

programme.title: AC/DC - Circus Krone
programme.desc: Filmed at the world famous Circus Krone in Munich, this AC/DC concert from June 17, 2003 features standout performances of Rock N Roll Damnation and What's Next To The Moon and more.

programme.title: The Moody Blues - Days of Future Passed Live
programme.desc: To celebrate the album's 50th anniversary, The Moody Blues brought it to life in front of a lively Toronto-based crowd in July 2017.

programme.title: Reasonable Doubt
programme.desc: In 1992, a small-time drug dealer was convicted of murdering a teenage boy. His sister and fiancée believe he is serving time for a crime he didn't commit.

programme.title: Murder In The Heartland
programme.desc: Sharon Ray is found dead in Grand Rivers, Kentucky. Loved ones wonder if she was living a lie when those closest to her become prime suspects.

programme.title: Muinaiset avaruusoliot
programme.desc: Raportit ufosieppauksista ovat lisääntyneet viime vuosina räjähdysmäisesti, ja joidenkin mukaan avaruusolennot valitsevat tiettyjä ihmisiä kertomaan maailmalle pian alkavasta uudesta ihmiskunnan aikakaudesta.

programme.title: Australian rajalla
programme.desc: Indonesiasta saapuneella miehellä ei omien sanojensa mukaan ole mitään tullattavaa. Konttitarkastuslaitoksessa selvitellään epäilyttävän kontin sisältöä.

programme.title: Australian rajalla
programme.desc: Taiwanista saapuu 13 matkustajaa, jotka väittävät, etteivät tunne toisiaan. Rajavartijat eivät kuitenkaan usko vakuutteluita. Postikeskuksessa tutkitaan kukkalähetystä.

programme.title: Sommar 2026 på Klädesholmen
programme.desc: Följ med oss till vackra ön Klädesholmen i Bohusläns skärgård 22-25 juli 2026. Intervjuer, vittnesbörd och sång och musik förgyller sommarkvällarna vid havet.

programme.title: Bushpiloterna - Farväl Afrika - Del 6
programme.desc: I Papua Nya Guinea ska Jan Ivar flyga ett hälsoteam till en by som aldrig tidigare fått medicinsk hjälp, men möts av dåliga nyheter när han landar. I Kongo säger Dave och Donna adjö efter ett långt liv som MAF-piloter, medan Josef och Christine ivrigt väntar på svar om de kommer att få resa som en ny pilotfamilj.

programme.title: Den dubbla strömmen del 2
programme.desc: Vi får återigen ta del av god undervisning i ämnet den dubbla strömmen där Sven Almkvist undervisar utifrån Hesekiel 47 om att komma ut i det Gud har för oss. I detta program pratar om Sven om vad som menas med den dubbla strömmen

programme.title: The Chosen Unveiled - Fördjupning: Jag är Han
programme.desc: Efter att ha fungerat som rådgivare till TV-serien The Chosen, utforskar den messianske rabbinen Jason Sobel olika teman och idéer bakom den framgångsrika serien. Ur både ett bibliskt och judiskt perspektiv lyfts dessa bitar fram på ett sätt som gör både serien och Bibeln mer levande för oss.

programme.title: Today with J. John
programme.desc: Weekly talk shoe with Rev. Canon J. John

programme.title: Jerusalem Dateline
programme.desc: Ett nyhetsprogram om veckans händelser i Israel ur ett bibliskt perspektiv.

programme.title: Orubbligt hopp - Gud
programme.desc: Max Lucado berättar om de löften som återfinns i Guds Ord som ger ett orubbligt hopp. När du står inför utmanande omständigheter kommer du att frestas att ge efter för hopplöshet. Men i dessa tider som dessa har du ett ovärderligt ankare - Gud är mer än kapabel att lyfta upp, återställa och stärka ditt trötta hjärta, och vad han lovar, kommer han att uppfylla.Detta avsnitt handlar om relationen till Gud, andlig krigföring, Guds rustning, Satan med utgångspunkt i Hebréerbrevet 8:11, Efesiebrevet 6:12-16 och Kolosserbrevet 2:15.

programme.title: Vem skrev sången - Fanny Crosby
programme.desc: ⁣Den amerikanska sångförfattaren Fanny Crosby skrev över 8600 sångtexter, varav några hör till våra mest älskade psalmer som Saliga visshet och Låt mig få höra om Jesus. Hon blev blind som litet spädbarn och menade att blindheten förde henne in i uppgifter som hon inte hade fått om hon kunnat se.I detta musikprogram berättar Mikael Järlestrand om några av tidernas mest legendariska tonsättare och framför sånger av dem tillsammans med ⁣pianist Marcus Ander.

programme.title: In my living room - Eleonora Lahti
programme.desc: Här delar jag händelser och tankar i mitt liv som sångerska, högstadielärare, mamma och medmänniska. In my living room blandas tårar med skratt och jag hoppas du lämnar rummet full av livslust och framtidstro.

programme.title: Aril Edvardsen Classics - Paradigmskiftet
programme.desc: Aril Edvardsen är sannolikt en av Nordens mest inflytelserika andliga ledare genom det missionsarbete han fick vara med och bygga upp. Från enkla förhållande på norska sörlandet tar han kallelsen ut i hela världen och oerhörda skaror har tagit emot Jesus Kristus genom Arils förkunnelse och missionens olika evangelister. Här får du ta del av Arils förkunnelse i samband med konferenser i Sarons Dal och på andra platser i Norge. Textat till svenska.

programme.title: Praise - Reza Safa
programme.desc: Som muslim från Iran var han starkt övertygad om att den enda rätta vägen var islam. Men när han kom till Sverige på 1980-talet och stötte på kristna skakades hans fasta övertygelse och han mötte Jesus. Gud kallade honom inte bara till att predika evangeliet utan att göra det på TV. Det ledde Reza Safa till Los Angeles där han idag leder program på TBN Nejat som når farsitalande med evangeliet.

programme.title: Relamore - Bibeln And sex
programme.desc: I detta program samtalar Britta Bolmenäs med psykologen och författaren Alf B Svensson om allt som har med relationer att göra. Det svåraste men också det bästa i livet. I detta avsnitt djupdyker Britt och Alf i ämnet sex. De pratar om hur bibeln ser på sex och Alf berättar hur hormoner påverkar dig mer än du tror.

programme.title: 30 min med Trosgnistan
programme.desc: I programmet 30 minuter med Trosgnistan får du en inblick i biståndsorganisationens arbete runtom i världen. Trosgnistans Mission är en allkristen missionsorganisation baserad i Betelförsamlingen i Runemo och bedriver arbete i 16 länder. Missionärer, biståndsarbetare och praktikanter är verksamma i några av de länder där Trosgnistans mission är representerad.

programme.title: Jag Är - Guds lamm
programme.desc: I detta program lyfter Hanna upp Jesus och genom sin konst gestaltar hon Jesus olika karaktärsdrag och titlar enligt Bibeln.

programme.title: Det hände här
programme.desc: 4/4. Anders Lundin och tre historiker åker till Mellerud i Dalsland. De hör en 250 år gammal mordgåta, ser världens största ballong och en spioncentral mitt i ett slumrande villakvarter.

programme.title: Fråga Lund
programme.desc: Kemisten Ulf reder äntligen ut vilken del av jordgubben som smakar mest och bäst. Historikern Gunnar berättar hur det gick till när glödlampan blev symbolen för en idé och så avslöjar evolutionsbiologen Jessica om det finns djur som kan blunda med öronen. Medverkande: Robin Paulsson, Gabriella Stenberg Wieser, Gunnar Wetterberg, Jessica Abbott, Ulf Ellervik och Henrik Widegren.

programme.title: Dox
programme.desc: Under belägringen av Sarajevo på 90-talet fanns en blomstrande underjordisk community i staden som fann hopp i musik och konst. 90-talets största rockband U2 engagerar sig i Sarajevos öde och sätter världens fokus på den förödande konflikten. I dokumentären får vi följa processen från att U2 lovar att genomföra en konsert i Sarajevo efter krigsslutet, fram till att konserten hålls inför 45 000 fans i den befriade staden. En film av Nenad Cicin-Sain. Originaltitel: Kiss the Future.

programme.title: Ett enklare liv
programme.desc: I ett av Afrikas mest outforskade områden driver Moli och Noelle en safaripark. Ben besöker deras läger där nattliga rovdjursbesök och bad i det flodhästbebodda vattendraget är en del av vardagen.

programme.title: Världens natur
programme.desc: Vi människor har spritt oss till jordens alla hörn och satt naturen under press. Men det finns djur som anpassar sig. Noshörningen i Nepal traskar som alltid mellan sina betesmarker fast en stad växt upp i hans väg och aporna på Bali stjäl turisternas värdesaker och lämnar tillbaka dem mot ersättning.

programme.title: Så gjordes Planet Earth III
programme.desc: Följ med bakom kulisserna och ta del av vilket arbete som krävs för att skapa en av världens mest spektakulära naturserier.

programme.title: Kungliga skandaler
programme.desc: Suzannah avslöjar några mystiska olösta kungliga dödsfall genom tiderna. Och var verkligen en kung inblandad i en svensk greves mystiska försvinnande? Och är det sant att drottning Victorias farbror mördade sin betjänt? Från medeltiden och fram till våra dagar har det brittiska kungahuset varit föremål för allehanda skandaler. Professor Suzannah Lipscomb undersöker kungliga skandaler genom tiderna.

programme.title: På resa i Medelhavet
programme.desc: Cypern bjuder på elva månader av solsken, kristallklart vatten och gyllene stränder. Vi möter unga entreprenörer som sätter en modern prägel på traditionell matkultur och vävare som skapar förändring i sina samhällen.

programme.title: Mellankrigstidens drömmar
programme.desc: Del 2 av 8: Freden. En serie om mellankrigstiden baserad på sanna berättelser från livet i en tid full av hopp och förtvivlan. Här följer vi ett antal människors livsöden, via deras autentiska dagböcker, brev och minnen.

programme.title: Vilda Korea
programme.desc: Koreas livsfarliga gräns - där norr möter söder - är en smal landremsa som i 65 år varit isolerad från världen. Nu är den koreanska demilitariserade zonen en av de vildaste och mest orörda livsmiljöerna för vilda djur i Asien.

programme.title: På resa med Bachstad: Japan
programme.desc: I Hachinohe sover Øystein i kejsarens säng och Rune möter Jesus. Norrmannen Snorre och hans chef bjuder in dem till en ordentlig runda på stan.

programme.title: Fråga Lund
programme.desc: Kemisten Ulf reder äntligen ut vilken del av jordgubben som smakar mest och bäst. programme.title: Världens natur
programme.desc: Vi människor har spritt oss till jordens alla hörn och satt naturen under press. Men det finns djur som anpassar sig. Noshörningen i Nepal traskar som alltid mellan sina betesmarker fast en stad växt upp i hans väg och aporna på Bali stjäl turisternas värdesaker och lämnar tillbaka dem mot ersättning.

programme.title: Så gjordes Planet Earth III
programme.desc: Följ med bakom kulisserna och ta del av vilket arbete som krävs för att skapa en av världens mest spektakulära naturserier.

programme.title: På resa i Medelhavet
programme.desc: Cypern bjuder på elva månader av solsken, kristallklart vatten och gyllene stränder. Vi möter unga entreprenörer som sätter en modern prägel på traditionell matkultur och vävare som skapar förändring i sina samhällen.

programme.title: Australiens sötaste rovdjur
programme.desc: Det finns massor av små pungdjur som lever i Australien. Men många av dessa är hotade. Här möter vi världens minst kända pungdjur och lär oss om deras listiga metoder att närma sig sitt byte.

programme.title: Historien om Sverige
programme.desc: Sverige är ett utblottat och uttröttat land, efter Karl XII:s ändlösa krig. Men ur askan växer något nytt fram. Nya sätt att tänka slår rot, handel och vetenskap blomstrar och nu kommer också nya idéer som tryckfrihet och folkligt inflytande. Men de idéerna kommer att stöta på motstånd.

programme.title: Historiskt eftersnack
programme.desc: Historiskt eftersnack tar tag i 1700-talet och diskuterar Gustav III och hans mamma, könssjukdomar och fylla. Och hur fri var egentligen Frihetstiden? Gäster är Karin Tegenborg Falkdalen, doktor i idéhistoria, Jonas Nordin, professor i bok- och bibliotekshistoria. och Emma Frans, doktor i medicinsk epidemiologi. Programledare är Cecilia Düringer.

programme.title: Kungliga skandaler
programme.desc: Suzannah avslöjar några mystiska olösta kungliga dödsfall genom tiderna. Och var verkligen en kung inblandad i en svensk greves mystiska försvinnande? Och är det sant att drottning Victorias farbror mördade sin betjänt? Från medeltiden och fram till våra dagar har det brittiska kungahuset varit föremål för allehanda skandaler. Professor Suzannah Lipscomb undersöker kungliga skandaler genom tiderna.

programme.title: Antikens riken
programme.desc: I en oregerlig värld måste våra forntida makter leda sitt folk, skapa sätt att styra och hålla upproret i schack. Vem kommer att hitta det rätta sättet att regera?

programme.title: Mellankrigstidens drömmar
programme.desc: Del 2 av 8: Freden. En serie om mellankrigstiden baserad på sanna berättelser från livet i en tid full av hopp och förtvivlan. Här följer vi ett antal människors livsöden, via deras autentiska dagböcker, brev och minnen.

programme.title: Amerikan rajavartijat: Meksiko
programme.desc: Yli puolet USA:n etelärajasta, Teksasin ja Meksikon välillä, muodostuu Rio Grandesta, jonka silloilla kuljetaan sekä laillisesti että laittomasti.

programme.title: Accident: A family portrait
programme.desc: Accident: A family portrait. Eugène-Auguste Ysaÿe: 6 Sonatas for solo violin. In ‘Accident’, death comes unexpectedly and abruptly to a family that has recently been challenged by the pater familia's marriage to a younger woman. When he dies suddenly, perhaps in a car accident, it becomes extremely important for her to push forward a delayed plan for a family portrait. How to take a family photo where one of the members is no longer alive, and the rest of the family, apart from the young wife, struggle to hide their opposition to the whole project? It is a grotesque task for the photographer, who routinely does everything possible to create a good atmosphere in the studio for his clients.. Directed by Jo Strømgren and Stein-Roger Bull 2021.

programme.title: Pierre Boulez, Académie du Festival de Lucerne
programme.desc: For over six decades, Pierre Boulez had a greater influence on the development of contemporary music than anyone else. Already in his younger days, he gained a reputation as a doughty champion of the avant-garde. With his compositions, interpretations and ideas, he indelibly shaped the international music scene – not only as a composer and conductor, but also as a music philosopher and teacher.

programme.title: Yehudi Menuhin, the Violin of the Century
programme.desc: Lord Yehudi Menuhin, relaxing at his home in the Greek isles, tells the story of his wonderful career on the eve of his 80th birthday. A wealth of rare archival material illustrates this highly informative and entertaining profile of the world's greatest violinist, providing insight into the life of the young San Franciscan wonderchild, his sudden rise to stardom which led to an outstanding international career, his encounters with the world's greatest musicians and music traditions, and his involvement in world politics.Subtitles available for this program with your remote control

programme.title: Aamusää

programme.title: Huomenta Suomi

programme.title: Afrikan salaiset ihmeet
programme.desc: Etiopia on rosoinen, sään karaisema maa, johon kätkeytyy luonnon aarteita.

programme.title: Afrikan salaiset ihmeet
programme.desc: Sahara on maailman suurin aavikko. Se on äärimmäinen ympäristö, joka peittää suuren osan Pohjois-Afrikasta. Pinnalta ei juuri löydy vettä tai ruokaa, ja se vaikuttaa täysin autiolta maalta. Kuitenkin piilossa sen sisuksissa asuu erityisiä lajeja, jotka ovat sopeutuneet elämään rankassa ympäristössä.

programme.title: Afrikan salaiset ihmeet
programme.desc: Sumun verhoama ja tiheiden viidakoiden rajaama Ruanda on salaperäinen maa.

programme.title: Etelä-Amerikan oudoimmat eläimet
programme.desc: Etelä-Amerikka on äärimäisyyksien maa. Tuhansia neliökilometrejä metsää, ruohikoita ja vuoria. Elämä täällä on vaikeaa, ja monet tunnetut eläimet ovat sopeutuneet joko kasvamalla todella isoiksi tai pieniksi, mutta jokainen niistä on hionut selviytymisstrategiansa huippuunsa.

programme.title: Afrikan salaiset ihmeet
programme.desc: Etiopia on rosoinen, sään karaisema maa, johon kätkeytyy luonnon aarteita.

programme.title: Afrikan salaiset ihmeet

programme.title: Saalistaja vastaan saalis
programme.desc: Tutustumme maailman voimakkaimpien petoeläinten – jääkarhujen – selviytymistaitoihin. Seuraamme emoa, joka kamppailee ruokkiakseen kahta pentuaan, ja nälkäkuoleman partaalle ajetun nuoren uroksen elämää ja paljastamme taktiikat, joita nämä mahtavat pedot käyttävät hylkeiden, valaiden ja mursujen jäljittämiseen ja väijymiseen.

programme.title: Eläimellistä kamppailua
programme.desc: Taisteluista lupaa tulla verisiä, kun leijonat ottavat toisistaan mittaa, harmaasusilauma ottaa yhteen harmaakarhun kanssa, virtahevot rymistävät rajun tappelun merkeissä ja maailman suurimpiin kuuluvan apinalajin edustaja suunnittelee murhaa. Luonto näyttää raaimman puolensa, kun himo, kateus ja silkka raivo ajavat luontokappaleet hengenvaarallisiin kohtaamisiin.

programme.title: Lyödään ällikällä
programme.desc: Isot alkuräjähdykset. Viihteellisessä peliohjelmassa ympäri maailmaa valittuja osallistujia pyydetään valitsemaan hurjien tieteellisten kokeiden oikea lopputulos.

programme.title: Turvatarkastus: Peru and Brasilia
programme.desc: Jorge Chavezin kansainväliselle lentokentän turvahenkilökunta työstentelee väsymättä pysäyttääkseen estääkseen huumeiden pääsyn maasta. Agentit ottavat kuulusteltavaksi eronneen pariskunnan, joka kieltää matkustansa yhdessä vaikka heillä on molemmilla mukanaan identtisiä huumepakkauksia. Seuraava epäilty yrittää piilotella huumeita käsimatkatavaroissaan. Miehen vatsalaukusta löytyy 35 huumepakkausta.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programme.desc: The International Canoe Federation (ICF) is the world governing body responsible for administering the sport of Canoeing, which includes both canoeing and kayaking. Governing eight disciplines, two of which are Olympic sports (Canoe Sprint and Canoe Slalom); the ICF delights us with competitions for these sports.While canoe slalom is a timed event where competitors navigate a whitewater course by passing through a combination of upstream and downstream gates, canoe sprint is a race to the line on a flatwater course. Both present a challenge for which athletes spend months, if not years, preparing for.Watch this extreme water sport and the two disciplines that take place in the Olympics: sprints and slalom.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programme.desc: The Sprint World Cup from the International Canoe Federation starts in Szeged, in the south of Hungary. This is the first Sprint World Cup of the 2018 season, and 700 athletes from 62 nations have been battling it out for the top spot. Who will raise to the top as the best nation in the sport? Find out on the highlights of the 2018 Sprint World Cup 1 Szeged.

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32
programme.desc: The GC32 Racing Tour is an international competition that allows regular sailors, both pros and keen amateurs, to get a taste of state of the art, flying, foil-born yacht racing at 30+ knot speeds. This competition offers thrilling emotions as pioneered in the America’s Cup, but at a fraction of the cost.Teams compete on a five-event circuit, mostly across Southern Europe, with the aim of raising with victory in the competition. Sailing across destinations as Oman, Riva del Garda, Lagos or Villasimius, the Speed Catamarans of GC32 Racing Tour propose exciting challenges to international teams.Follow the competition now to find out the fastest Catamarans on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Les Voiles de Saint Tropez
programme.desc: Spanning over 15 days, Les Voiles de St Tropez Regatta is the closing event of the summer season in St Tropez and the Riviera as a whole. Over 300 vessels and more than 4,000 sailors unite in Les Voiles de Saint Tropez for a week of racing and festivities, making it a must-go for all nautical enthusiasts.Multiple races take place throughout the duration of the event and there is always something for everyone to do, see and enjoy. Boats of a variety of categories including futuristic prototypes, maxi yachts, wally yachts and more will prove their performance among a variety of courses.Sail off to the Mediterranean Sea with Les Voiles de Saint Tropez, exclusively on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Mr. Price Pro Ballito
programme.desc: Follow the world leaders of surfing as they come to South Africa, Willard beach Ballito. 96 competitors from 18 countries will surf for the 250,000$ prize. Also, music concerts filled with South African bands will be cheering the best surfers of the world with their jamming.

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise
programme.desc: Anchored in Paradise

programme.title: Wind Masters
programme.desc: Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.​In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. From the famous city of Dubrovnik, which is the most prominent tourist destination in the Mediterranean, to the beautiful island of Korcula, which will enchant your senses with its ancient history.​If Croatia have crept onto your holidays’ radar, Wind Masters is perfect for you. This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.​

programme.title: A Surfing Life: David Van Zyl
programme.desc: David Van Zyl is a young South-African surfer that is quickly gaining popularity and becoming a rising star on the pro-surfer scene. For surf connoisseurs, his name has made history in 2019 as the first International Surfer to ever win the Vans Pro competition in Hawaii. Before then, Hawaiian surfers had an undefeated upper hand that was finally overcome by this young underdog. He now faces new challenges to engrave his name in fame.Get ready to catch some South African waves with David Van Zyl and find out more about his lifestyle on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Sail-Ho

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: We will visit the beautiful historical city of Šibenik, explore fascinating Šibenik channel and the Krka river, learn a bit about unique coral handmade jewelry, visit a very interesting museum on the island of Prvić and much more!

programme.title: Kite Masters
programme.desc: Welcome to Kite Masters!The series that flies you around the world, together with the very best athletes from one of the fastest, most extreme and stylish sports: kiteboarding. For some people kiteboarding is a hobby, for others it’s a performance, but for many it’s life.We bring the most passionate athletes experience inside the sport to the screen. We’ll take a look back over all the happenings earlier this season in the extreme world of kiteboarding, and the transformation of the sport on the road to Paris 2024.Follow these pro athletes on their journey to become the best in their fields and their evolution throughout the years. Now available, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: 52 Super Series
programme.desc: Established as the world’s leading grand prix for monohull yacht, the 52 Super Series is a yacht racing circuit like no other. The circuit grew from the ashes of the TP52 MedCup that finished in 2011 in an initiative by three key stakeholders who enjoyed this race so much they wanted to keep it alive.The 52 Super Series embraces like-minded individuals and crews in venues and locations enjoyed by all. This is a series for the best. From Olympic medallists to America’s Cup victors, the dockside is filled with talent.Watch the racing circuit as yachts speed well over 20 knots and representing sailors from over 20 different nationalities in this sustainable event. Competitors race on a simple first-past-the-post format, so real time racing is all that matters, as there is no post-race time compensation.Find out what makes the 52 Super Series the best monohull racing in the world.

programme.title: Semaine De Saint Barthelemy
programme.desc: From 800 to 900 sailors, from 17 different countries, are expected to come to the Caribbean island of St. Barths for this event. As usual, St. Barths is ready to offer its best qualities, both ashore and at sea, in order to welcome all these people keen on nice sailing races, in the delightful setting of these islands.

programme.title: MAR
programme.desc: Surfing has ceased a long time ago to be considered a niche sport. As the mainstream industry discovers its potential for selling clothes, trips and a whole set of ‘lifestyle’ products, there are those who appreciate it for what it is in its purest form – a direct connection to mother nature.We accompany Big Wave surfer Alex Botelho and some of his friends to meet surfers who balance their love for the ocean and nature with a professional career in the sport. Mar is a tale of discovery, triumph and (almost) tragedy, but above all it is a life affirming pledge to positive vibes in and out of the line-up.Get ready to soak up a new conception of the world of surf as Alex Botelho unveils concepts unknown for the mainstream audience, available on Nautical Channel.Awards:Best Feature Documentary – Best Istanbul Film Festival 2021. Official Selections 2021: Ocean Film Festival World Tour, International Ocean Film Festival.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM F1H2O World Championship is the flagship series of international single-seater inshore circuit Formula powerboat racing. It attracts up to 20 of the world’s leading drivers from 13 countries who navigate the lightweight, tunnel-hull catamarans reaching speeds in excess of 240km/h on the straights.Watch them race through the water in an epic H20 Racing: F1H20 World Championship that has nothing to envy from land F1, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: Inside Superyachts
programme.desc: Speed is the name of the game in this episode as we visit Dutch shipyard Heesen Yachts, renowned builder of record breaking, fast, lightweight aluminium superyachts. We talk to naval architects ‘Omega’ and we get an onboard look at the racing colour design of M/Y Aurelia, designed by Bannenberg And Rowell. Finally, no yacht would be complete without the latest technology and fastest onboard gadgets. We discover just what’s hot on a yacht with the most sought-after tech and AV firm, IdeaWorks.

programme.title: Inside Superyachts
programme.desc: Italians are known for their quality and style, and their superyachts are no different. Undoubtedly the largest and most famous of Italian builders is Perini Navi, makers of one of the most ecologically friendly superyachts in the world, the Maltese Falcon. We meet with designer Ken Frievokh and engineer Damon Roberts to understand the technology behind their ground-breaking dyna-rig onboard the Maltese Falcon.We then take a look at some of the finest Italian boats built by one of the fastest growing shipyards: Mondomarine. We get an all access introduction to Viareggio’s Sealyon, whose opulent and glamorous interiors were designed by Martin Kemp at Candy And Candy.

programme.title: The South To Sian Journals
programme.desc: A collection of stories documenting the people, places And adventures that occurred during the 2 years making “South To Sian” - the challenges, the surfers, riders, shapers, bike builders, filmmakers and photographers. Extremely entertaining and insightful, “Journals” documents the travels, the hardships, the spectacular locations, the personalities and the thoughts of the characters, both in front of and behind the lens.

programme.title: Salon Nautique Paris
programme.desc: The annual event to discover the nautical novelties of the coming season. A showcase of close to 785 exhibitors and 1,300 brands for an attendance of over 240,000 visitors, 1200 boats on display including nearly 200 new features!

programme.title: Jump On Board
programme.desc: We are approaching our end of our trip and the next stop is Skiros. With the morning breeze we leave past the serene and calm location behind us on route to Skiros. Local dances, fun and life at sea are some of the things Greece has to offer, and in this short time we have seen how great friendships have started.

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32

programme.title: Les Voiles de Saint Tropez

programme.title: OFQUI
programme.desc: The Isthmus of Ofqui, unknown for many and chosen as surf destination by few adventurers.The stretch of land that separates the Pacific Ocean's inland seas, is the only way to make it if you want to surf the shores of Golfo de Penas. Connecting the Taitao Peninsula with the Chilean mainland, Ofqui offers world class waves. This thaw surf film approaches the vast territory of the Patagonia in different ways, this time, centered around Ofqui.Pro surfers will face ice-cold waters in their expedition to surf deathly waves in Ofqui, one of the most unknown locations of the Patagonia and with a microclimate that maximises the upcoming waves.Join them in their adventure to Ofqui here, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Moana Waiwai
programme.desc: Moana Waiwai follows the Free Swim journey of wahine (woman) Ally Davey as she takes on 70km of open ocean around the stunning Coromandel coastline to bring awareness to the protection of New Zealand’s oceans. For over three days it does more than encapsulate stunning panoramas on the extraordinary scenario of New Zealand. It is also inspiring for people as we become aware of the natural beauty of the ocean so we can protect it before it is too late. This is an inspirational film, not an activist propaganda, that highlights exploration and the intrinsic benefits of getting wet and looking below the surface. In Moana Waiwai Ally Davey will champion endurance of her human spirit in this seemingly impossible task to achieve a higher goal: protection of the oceans. Be part of her adventure on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Linea Blu
programme.desc: Prosegue a Trapani, nella Sicilia occidentale, il viaggio di Linea Blu – Porti d'Italia, la trasmissione condotta da Donatella Bianchi e Livio Beshir, realizzata in collaborazione con il Ministero delle Infrastrutture e dei Trasporti e l'Autorità di Sistema Portuale. Donatella dà il via ad un itinerario nel Mediterraneo occidentale che unisce la salvaguardia ambientale dell'Area Marina Protetta Isole Egadi alla ricchezza storica del porto di Trapani, passando per l'archeologia subacquea, l'ittiturismo e l'integrazione culturale a tavola. Costeggiando in barca a vela le mura di Tramontana, dal Lazzaretto alla Colombaia, Livio racconta la storia del porto di Trapani, nato come sbocco commerciale per l'antica città di Eryx, l'attuale Erice, poi diventato scalo di riferimento per i traffici marittimi tra la Sicilia e il Nordafrica. A Favignana, presso Cala Pozzo, le telecamere di Linea Blu – Porti D'Italia documentano poi le attività di monitoraggio ambientale a bordo dei mezzi dell'Area Marina Protetta. Il racconto prosegue sulle rotte quotidiane che collegano Trapani con le isole Egadi, dove Donatella incontra Salvo, direttore di sala macchine ma anche musicista. Navigando nelle acque che circondano il suggestivo Faro di Porcelli, Livio incontra invece Natale, impegnato nella tradizionale pesca delle aragoste. Spazio anche alle bellezze nascoste nei fondali: al largo di Favignana, il pescatore Filippo Abbione racconta il ritrovamento del relitto di un'antica nave araba. Il viaggio si conclude a Trapani, tra i vicoli del quartiere ebraico. Qui la cuoca Hajer Aissi, di origini tunisine ma siciliana d'adozione, prepara il tradizionale cous cous trapanese di pesce e semola, simbolo perfetto dello storico incontro tra culture che caratterizza il Mediterraneo.

programme.title: Linea Verde Estate
programme.desc: Linea Verde racconta la Sicilia sud-orientale, tra Noto, Marzamemi e l'Oasi di Vendicari, dove la luce diventa identità, energia e filo invisibile che unisce paesaggio e tradizioni. Il viaggio di Nicola 'Tinto' Prudente e Margherita Granbassi prende il via da Noto, dove la luce esalta la bellezza del barocco e trasforma la città in un autentico palcoscenico di pietra e colori. Il percorso di Tinto prosegue nelle campagne, dove incontra i protagonisti di un'agricoltura biologica che guarda al futuro senza dimenticare la tradizione. Una Sicilia capace di reinventarsi, trasformando le sfide dei cambiamenti climatici in nuove opportunità di sviluppo. A Marzamemi la luce cambia scenario: si riflette sul bianco delle case, sul blu intenso del mare e sulle antiche tradizioni della pesca. Non manca un incontro dedicato alla cucina di casa, dove ricette tramandate da generazioni raccontano il valore della memoria e della convivialità. Il percorso di Margherita inizia invece nel cuore di Noto, dove il sole esalta la straordinaria bellezza della pietra dorata che ha reso celebre il barocco della città. Dopo averne scoperto i segreti, raggiunge una cava dismessa per incontrare uno scultore erede dell'antica tradizione degli scalpellini netini. La tappa successiva è l'Oasi di Vendicari, uno dei più importanti scrigni di biodiversità del Mediterraneo. Qui Margherita incontra un fotografo naturalista che da anni osserva questo ecosistema straordinario. A chiusura del viaggio Tinto e Margherita si ritrovano nel cuore di Noto davanti alla Cattedrale, per condividere i sapori della tradizione siciliana tra granite e specialità locali.

programme.title: Noos - L'avventura della conoscenza
programme.desc: La copertina della nuova puntata è dedicata alla forma fisica e cioè allo stato generale di salute e benessere di una persona. Quando la nostra forma fisica è buona svolgiamo attività quotidiane con energia, efficienza e senza eccessiva fatica. Ma cosa succede se invece andiamo fuori forma? Con la dottoressa Anna Maria Colao, docente ordinaria di endocrinologia e malattie del metabolismo presso l'università Federico II di Napoli, si parla di obesità e di salute partendo da un presupposto fondamentale: l'obesità è una malattia cronica e recidivante e la società deve garantire i servizi essenziali di assistenza e di cura. Spazio poi ad un approfondimento sulle prossime missioni spaziali con Luca Parmitano che, in collegamento da Houston, racconta ad Alberto Angela l'emozione di far parte dell'equipaggio dell'Artemis III, il team di astronauti che sperimenterà nell'orbita terrestre le nuove tecnologie che apriranno la via verso la luna. Il futuro è anche il tema del servizio dedicato alle auto a guida autonoma con un viaggio nella tecnologia dei trasporti con l'astrofisico Luca Perri. Se ne discute poi con il filosofo Luciano Floridi, tra le voci più autorevoli nel campo della filosofia dell'informazione. Spazio poi a Dario Fabbri con un'analisi delle dinamiche geopolitiche mondiali, la fisica Giuliana Galati, l'astrofisica Edwige Pezzulli, il sessuologo Emmanuele Jannini, mentre Carlo Lucarelli racconta la storia del serial killer John Wayne Gacy, il clown assassino. Spazio anche alla medicina, con il racconto della cura dei grandi ustionati e delle nuove frontiere della pelle ricostruita in laboratorio, tra i reparti dell'Ospedale Niguarda di Milano e le startup biotech internazionali. Infine, con il paleontologo Alfio Alessandro Chiarenza, un salto nella preistoria porta alla Jurassic Coast inglese, alla scoperta dei giganteschi rettili marini del Giurassico.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Das CSI-Team sucht immer noch nach den verschwundenen jungen Frauen und ihrer Kollegin Morgan Brody, die in einer riskanten Operation als Lockvogel diente. Die Suche führt die Ermittler zu einem Lagerhaus, wo sie eine tote, junge Frau finden, die Morgan zum Verwechseln ähnlich sieht.Jake, der Fahrer des Wagens, mit dem Morgan Brody verschwand, streitet weiterhin alles ab und verweist die Ermittler an Bruder Larson. Daniel Larson wiederum ist der Ansicht, dass nur Oliver Tate aufgrund seiner Obsession in der Lage ist, derartige Verbrechen zu begehen. Als Zeugen benennt er Angela, alias Miss Kitty, die allerdings verschwunden ist. Auf der gefundenen Leiche finden die Ermittler Material, das Henry als synthetische DNS identifiziert. Bei der Durchsuchung von Tates Wohnräumen findet Julie Finlay einen kleinen Behälter mit künstlicher DNS, identisch mit der, die an der Leiche gefunden wurde. Mittlerweile hat sich der Mörder mit einer weiteren Botschaft an die Polizei gewandt: Morgan Brody muss einen biblischen Text verlesen und anschließend die Polizei dazu auffordern, sich zwischen ihr und Ellie Brass zu entscheiden.Dann bekommt D.B. einen Anruf von Angela, die um ein Treffen bittet, doch als D.B. eintrifft, ist Angela bereits tot. Fast zeitgleich fliegt der Hauptverdächtige Tate mit seinem Wagen in die Luft. Als es Nick gelingt, über einen Fingerabdruck auf der Fernsteuerung für die Autobombe, die Tate ins Jenseits befördert hat, die Verbindung zu Jakes Bruder Matthew herzustellen, sind die Ermittler einen großen Schritt weitergekommen. Morgan ist es unterdessen gelungen, ihren Peiniger zu überwältigen, sie ahnt jedoch nicht, dass ihr Grauen noch nicht vorbei ist und ein schreckliches Ende nehmen wird.

Als Johannas Arbeit in der Bank bei Emma für Neugier und Begeisterung sorgt, kann sich Jonas einen kritischen Kommentar nicht verkneifen ...

programme.title: Undercover Boss
programme.desc: Alexander Tauer, der Chef von Domino's, verkleidet sich, um undercover in seinen Filialen zu arbeiten und Missstände aufzudecken. Er möchte das Unternehmen auf 1.000 Filialen erweitern, sieht sich aber mit Personalengpässen konfrontiert.

programme.title: Undercover Boss
programme.desc: Die Rudolf Wöhrl SE ist ein fränkisch-bayerisches Mode-Einzelhandelsunternehmen und beschäftigt rund 1700 Mitarbeiter. Thomas Weckerlein ist seit 2017 Mitglied des Vorstands und verwandelt sich mit grauen Haarverlängerungen, einem Vollbart und schrägen Klamotten in einen Altrocker. Sein ausgefallenes Äußeres und seine Kurzsichtigkeit machen ihm das Arbeiten in den Modenhäusern schwer. Er versucht sich als Verkäufer, Dekorateur und Schneider.

programme.title: SPIEGEL TV
programme.desc: Drogenschmuggel: Koks, Bananen und der HaiDeutschland erlebt eine beispiellose Kokain-Schwemme - längst keine Seltenheit mehr, dass der Zoll das weiße Pulver gleich tonnenweise in Containern aus Südamerika entdeckt. SPIEGEL TV zeichnet einen der spektakulärsten Fälle der vergangenen Jahre nach - mit exklusiven Einblicken in die geheime Kommunikation der Drogenschmuggler mit ihrer Führungsriege. Das Bundeskriminalamt äußert sich erstmals vor einer Kamera zu den Ermittlungen gegen die international bestens vernetzte Bande, deren Kopf aus einer Kleinstadt in Norddeutschland die Fäden zog. Insgesamt geht es um acht Tonnen Kokain, das unter anderem in Bananenkisten versteckt nach Europa verschifft wurde. Eine zentrale Rolle spielt dabei ein Berufskrimineller aus dem Kosovo. Seine Geschichte liest sich wie ein Krimi, der schon in den 90er Jahren mit einem spektakulären Gefängnisausbruch in Norwegen beginnt. Ein Drogenboss, den alle in der Unterwelt nur bei seinem Spitznamen nennen: der Hai.

programme.title: RTL Nachtjournal
programme.desc: Im Mittelpunkt des Nachrichtenjournals RTL Nachtjournal steht die vertiefende aktuelle Berichterstattung. Das Thema des Tages wird regelmäßig durch kritische Interviews mit Verantwortlichen aus Politik und Wirtschaft beleuchtet.

programme.title: Alltagskämpfer - So tickt Deutschland!
programme.desc: Die stark frequentierte A24 verbindet Hamburg und Berlin. Das Autobahnpolizeirevier Stolpe überwacht die Strecke. In manchen Monaten ahnden die Beamten über 15.000 Geschwindigkeitsverstöße. Begleitet wird die Autobahnpolizei im Einsatz.

programme.title: Seitenwechsel - Die Welt mit anderen Augen sehen
programme.desc: Brutale Messerangriffe in deutschen Städten sorgen immer häufiger für Ängste. Jeffrey Lemke und sein Team überwachen durch anlasslose Kontrollen Berliner Waffen- und Messerverbotszonen. Doch die Maßnahmen stehen in der Kritik.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: 15 Jahre nach ihrem Schulabschluss sehen sich die Schüler einer Highschool bei einem Klassentreffen wieder. Während der Veranstaltung wird einer von ihnen mit einer Champagnerflasche erschlagen. Das Opfer gehörte zwar zu Schulzeiten zu den angesagtesten Personen auf dem Campus, doch seine arrogante und rücksichtslose Art verschaffte ihm auch viele Feinde. Die Liste derer, die sauer auf den mittlerweile erfolgreichen Geschäftsmann waren, ist lang.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: Aufgrund von Ermittlungsfehlern wird die Hinrichtung des Mörders Kramer verschoben. Er wurde beschuldigt, ein Pärchen mit einer Axt erschlagen zu haben. Da die DNA-Untersuchungen offenbar schlampig durchgeführt worden sind, muss Horatio den Fall noch mal aufnehmen. Das Team arbeitet unter Hochdruck und kommt zu einem schockierenden Ergebnis: Es muss einen zweiten Täter gegeben haben. Horatio verdächtigt einen Cousin von Kramer.

programme.title: Der Blaulicht Report - Einzeleinsätze
programme.desc: Ob Raubüberfall, Brandstiftung oder hilflose Personen - die Arbeit von Polizisten, Notärzten und Rettungssanitätern erfordert nicht nur Sachkenntnis, sondern auch Einfühlungsvermögen und Durchsetzungskraft. Häufig sind sie gemeinsam vor Ort, wenn rund um einen Polizeieinsatz medizinische Erstversorgung gefragt ist. Der Blaulicht Report erzählt Geschichten aus dem aufregenden Berufsalltag dieser Retter in Not.

programme.title: Der Blaulicht Report - Einzeleinsätze
programme.desc: Ob Raubüberfall, Brandstiftung oder hilflose Personen - die Arbeit von Polizisten, Notärzten und Rettungssanitätern erfordert nicht nur Sachkenntnis, sondern auch Einfühlungsvermögen und Durchsetzungskraft. Häufig sind sie gemeinsam vor Ort, wenn rund um einen Polizeieinsatz medizinische Erstversorgung gefragt ist. Der Blaulicht Report erzählt Geschichten aus dem aufregenden Berufsalltag dieser Retter in Not.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Der Absturz einer Chartermaschine erweist sich schon rasch als Folge eines Sabotageakts. Bei den Ermittlungen trifft Sara einen alten Bekannten wieder: Doug Wilson.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Theresa Shea, eine bekannte Fernsehmoderatorin, wird während eines Stromausfalls an ihrem Arbeitsplatz ermordet. Die Ermittler stehen vor einem Rätsel, weil sich Theresa in einem abgeschlossenen Studio befand. Dann entdeckt D.B. Russell, dass der Stromausfall durch eine ferngezündete Bombe im Transformator neben dem Sender ausgelöst wurde. Offenbar war Theresa einer 17 Jahre alten, ungeklärten Brandanschlagsserie auf der Spur.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Die junge Tennisspielerin Claudia Weber steht erstmals im Finale eines Profiturniers. Doch am Morgen vor dem Spiel wird sie tot aufgefunden. Die Obduktion zeigt, dass sie schon früher schwere Kopf- und Hirnverletzungen erlitten hat.

programme.title: Deutschland am Morgen
programme.desc: Dein Morgen, dein Rhythmus: Deutschland am Morgen von RTL und ntv ist der tägliche Begleiter für alle, die bestens informiert und gut unterhalten in den Tag starten wollen. Von 6 bis 9 Uhr liefert das Nachrichtenmagazin die wichtigsten Themen und ordnet sie verständlich ein. Ob Politik, Wirtschaft, Sport oder Service: Feste Rubriken und spannende Talks sorgen für den richtigen Takt am Morgen.

programme.title: Ninas resa (12)
programme.desc: Tositapahtumiin perustuva draama teini-ikäisen Ninan ja tämän perheen elämästä Varsovan getossa toisen maailmansodan aikana. Nina rakastuu, juhlii, opiskelee ja valmistuu ylioppilaaksi. Samalla ihmiset hänen ympärillään katoavat yksi toisensa jälkeen. Elokuva perustuu ohjaaja Lena Einhornin kirjaan äitinsä nuoruusvuosista, ja se sai kaksi Guldbagge-palkintoa (paras elokuva, paras käsikirjoitus).

programme.title: Kohtalokas syrjähyppy (16)
programme.desc: Kaunis runoilija Clara rakastuu tulisesti John Hjortfeldtiin. Hän jättää mustasukkaisen miehensä Johnin takia. Perheellinen John taas alkaa elää kaksoiselämää. Clara huomaa, että häntä seurataan ja vahditaan. Kuka on asialla, ja miksi?

programme.title: Monica Z (12)
programme.desc: Monica, nuori, kapinallinen pikkukaupungin tyttö on päättänyt menestyä laulajana Tukholman eloisilla jazzklubeilla. Hän aloittaa unelmiensa laulajan uran, jonka aikana upea laulaja/näyttelijä kehittyy jazzin kultaisella aikakaudella.

programme.title: Krakel Spektakel
programme.desc: Ruotsalainen koko perheen musikaalielokuva Annabell Olssonin seikkailuista. Perustuu Lennart Hellsingin teksteihin ja Poul Ströyerin kuvitukseen.

programme.title: Lasinpuhaltajan lapset (S)
programme.desc: Joen toisella puolella suuressa linnassa asuu Valtiatar Valtiattarensa kanssa. Valtiaan suurin ilo on, kun hän saa totella Valtiatarta. Eräänä päivänä hän toivoo että hänellä olisi lapsia, pieni poika ja pieni tyttö...

programme.title: Eemeli ja possuressu (7)
programme.desc: Eemeli tekee enemmän metkuja kuin mitä vuodessa on päiviä, hänen äidillään on tapana sanoa. Mutta tekee hän muutakin! Tällä kertaa Eemeli muun muassa pelastaa vastasyntyneen possun hengen.

programme.title: Miffo (12)
programme.desc: Tobias on tuore pappi, joka saa työn Tukholman köyhimpiin kuuluvasta lähiöstä. Hän tapaa Carolan, joka on sosiaalituella elävä rullatuolipotilas joka asuu alkoholisoituneen äitinsä kanssa. Tobias rakastuu, mutta kohtaavatko eri maailmat?

programme.title: Päivä päivältä (12)
programme.desc: Kertomus siitä, ettei irtiotto elämässä ole koskaan liian myöhäistä. Demontoitunut Tage sekä Malte ja Rut asuvat vanhainkodissa. Siellä työskentelevät myös hoitaja Katrin ja siivooja Simon. Yhdessä tämä viisikko reissaa matkailuautolla halki Euroopan täyttääkseen vanhan miehen viimeisen toiveen. Ohjaaja: Felix Herngren. Rooleissa: Martina Haag, Sven Wollter, Marianne Mörck, William Spetz, Tomas von Brömssen, Peter Magnusson, Felix Herngren. (Ruotsi, 2022.)

programme.title: Vägen ut
programme.desc: Kun Reine pakotetaan töihin vapaa-ajanpedagogiksi vankilaan, hän saa hullun idean - hän tekee näytelmän vankien kanssa! Kukaan ei ole aluksi kiinnostunut, mutta lopulta viisi vankia suostuu teatteripuuhiin - yrityksenään paeta!

programme.title: Enkelten talo - toinen kesä (7)
programme.desc: Uusi, mullistava kesä alkaa, kun Fanny ja Zac palaavat Enkelten taloon. Riidat ja kaksinaismoraali ovat tallella yhtä terävinä kuin ennenkin. Paljastuu että Gottfridillä ja Ivarilla on veli Sven, joka muutti Amerikkaan lapsena. Heidän etsimisestään ei ole koskaan ollut puhetta. Hänhän asuu Amerikassa - ja Gottfrid ja Ivar eivät ole käyneet edes Göteborgissa. He eivät kuitenkaan mahda Fannyn suostuttelulle mitään ja löytävät itsensä New Yorkista.

programme.title: Glädjekällan (7)
programme.desc: Kiitetty draama Ragnarista, joka lähtee perheensä rakkaaseen kesäpaikkaan levittääkseen sinne vaimonsa tuhkat. Siitä tulee matka täynnä yllätyksiä.

programme.title: Göta Kanal 2 (12)
programme.desc: 25 vuotta sitten kaksi laivaa purjehti kilpaa Götan kanavan läpi. Tapaus nousi kuuluisuuteen. Nyt on uuden kilpailun aika, ja tällä kertaa laivoja seuraa tuotantoyhtiö, joka on tehnyt kilpailusta livenä lähetetyn saippuadokumentin.

programme.title: Hyvää iltaa, herra Wallenberg (16)
programme.desc: Tositapahtumiin perustuva draama ruotsalaisesta poliitikosta, joka pelasti II MS:n aikana juutalaisia Budapestista Ruotsiin.

programme.title: Kesä Monikan kanssa (16)
programme.desc: Nuoret rakastavaiset Harry ja Monika pakenevat arkista todellisuutta kesäksi saaristoon mutta syksyn lähestyessä he huomaavat rakkautensa haalistuneen. Ohjaaja: Ingmar Bergman. Pääosissa: Harriet Andersson ja Lars Ekborg. (Sommaren med Monika, Ruotsi 1952)

programme.title: Yksinkertainen murhaaja (16)
programme.desc: Svenillä on huulihalkio, ja koska hänen puhettaan on vaikea ymmärtää, ihmiset kutsuvat häntä Idiootiksi. Kun Svenin äiti kuolee, hänet annetaan tehdaspomo Höglundille, julmalle miehelle, joka kiduttaa mielellään läheisiään.

programme.title: Hypnotisoija (16)
programme.desc: Synkkänä joulukuisena yönä psykiatri Erik Maria Bark herää, kun hänelle soitetaan tukholmalaisesta sairaalasta. Rikosetsivä Joona Linna pyytää häntä auttamaan akuutista traumasta kärsivän tajuttoman potilaan hoitamisessa.

programme.title: Flykten till framtiden (S)
programme.desc: Ruotsalainen aikamatkakomedia, jossa sydänvikainen nuorimies lähtee 70-luvun Tukholmasta metrolla seikkailemaan meidän aikaamme.

programme.title: Klara (S)
programme.desc: Klara muuttaa uuteen kaupunkiin ja hänellä on vaikeuksia löytää uusia kavereita. Uudet luokkakaverit pitävät ratsastuksesta, joten Klarakin lähtee tallille. Pian hän ilmottautuu jo esteratsastuskisaan, vaikka ei osaa vielä edes ratsastaa. Hevospiireissä hän kuitenkin tapaa suloisen Jonte-pojan. Ruotsalainen koko perheen elokuva.

programme.title: Ogifta par – en film som skiljer sig (7)
programme.desc: Komedia modernin avioliiton haasteista. Marie ja David ovat pariskunta, jonka on vaikeaa päättää ollako yhdessä vai ei. Heidän parhaat ystävänsä taas ovat täydellinen pari. Vai ovatko? Itse asiassa heidän elämänsä on varsin ankeaa, ja he tekevät kaikkensa välttääkseen jokapäiväistä elämää kuohuttavia konflikteja. Oli miten oli, kaikki neljä päättävät lähteä viettämään mökkijoulua Sälenille...

programme.title: Viimeinen tanssi (7)
programme.desc: Colin Nutleyn draamatrilleri sijoittuu Blackpoolissa järjestettävään tanssikilpailuun, johon osallistuu ruotsalaispareja. Yksi osallistuja murhataan.

programme.title: Onnen kukkuloilla (7)
programme.desc: Ruotsalainen romanttinen komedia eri-ikäisistä ihmisistä, joiden elämät punoutuvat yhteen sattumien ja rakkaudenkaipuun ansiosta.

programme.title: Bäst före (7)
programme.desc: Draamakomedia kolmesta vanhasta ystävästä, jotka voittavat rahaa raveissa ja päättävät lähteä Suomen-risteilylle.

programme.title: Pahuus (16)
programme.desc: Pahuus ja väkivalta varjostavat 16-vuotiaan Erikin elämää sekä kotona että koulun pihalla. Lopulta hänet erotetaan koulusta ja lähetetään Stjärnsbergin sisäoppilaitokseen. Tämä on Erikin viimeinen mahdollisuus riistäytyä vapaaksi entisestä elämästään. Stjärnsbergin koulu kuitenkin antaa vanhempien oppilaiden sortaa nuorempia oppilaita järjestelmällisesti.

programme.title: Täältä tullaan tulevaisuus (7)
programme.desc: Kaksi parikymppistä tyttöä tapaa Poliisikoulun pääsykokeissa. Heillä on hyvin erilaiset taustat mutta silti he ovat hyvin samanlaisia. Tiukat pääsykokeet, sotkuiset rakkaussuhteet ja herkät perhesuhteet koettelevat heidän ystävyyttään.

programme.title: Katto-Kassinen
programme.desc: Katto-Kassinen on kaunis, ihmeen viisas ja sopivan lihava mies parhaassa iässä. Eräänä päivänä hän lentää Pikkuveljen luokse ja heistä tulee ystäviä.

programme.title: Jonain päivänä kaikki tämä on sinun (7)
programme.desc: Menestynyt sarjakuvapiirtäjä Lisa kokoontuu sisaruksineen vanhempiensa maatilalle ensimmäisen kerran yli kymmeneen vuoteen. Vanhemmat haluavat, että vain yksi sisaruksista perii suvun metsän. Mutta onko kukaan heistä halukas muuttamaan takaisin kotiin? Andreas Öhmanin (Avaruudessa ei ole tunteita) ohjaaman draamakomedian tähtinä ovat Karin Franz Körlof, Peter Haber, Suzanne Reuter ja Liv Mjönes.

programme.title: Stieg Larsson: Mies joka leikki tulella (12)
programme.desc: Ruotsalainen dokumenttielokuva Millennium-kirjojen luojasta Stieg Larssonista ja hänen riskialttiista tutkimuksistaan äärioikeistoryhmien parissa.

programme.title: Peitenimi Coq Rouge (16)
programme.desc: Ensimmäinen elokuva huippukoulutetusta tiedustelupalvelun salaisesta agentista, joka saa tehtäväkseen tutkia Ruotsissa suunniteltua operaatiota.

programme.title: Kuin kuvastimessa (16)
programme.desc: Toisistaan vieraantuneet perheenjäsenet, isä, poika, tytär ja tämän mies päätyvät päiväksi kesänviettopaikkaan saarelle. Kaikki ovat sisimpänsä vankeja, vaikka heillä on sanaton ja tukahdutettu tarve saada yhteys toisiin. Heissä asuu myös hellyyden kaipuu, mikä johtaa kipeisiin välienselvittelyihin.

programme.title: Rahalla saa (16)
programme.desc: Kolme hyvin erilaista ihmistä kohtaa Tukholman alamaailmassa, ja seuraukset ovat väkivaltaiset. Jorge on karannut vankilasta. Mrado on jugoslavialaismafian velanperijä. JN on töissä kaupungin kuumimmissa mestoissa.

programme.title: Ikuistetut hetket (12)
programme.desc: (Maria Larssons eviga ögönblick, Ruotsi 2008) 1900-luvun alussa työläisnainen voittaa arpajaisissa kameran, joka mullistaa hänen elämänsä. Perustuu tositapahtumiin. O: Jan Troell. N: Maria Heiskanen, Mikael Persbrandt.

programme.title: Tuppen (7)
programme.desc: Vuosi 1944. Miehet ovat sotilaina, ympäri maata unelmoidaan rauhasta ja aidosta kahvista. Örnen i Ryd -tekstiilitehtaassa elämä kulkee omalla painollaan. Yhtäkkiä uusi insinööri Cederquist ilmestyy paikalle, ja tehdas on täynnä tyttöjä...

programme.title: Lapin poliisit

programme.title: Christine Kamau - jazzahead! 2024 - Christine Kamau (KE)
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community’s most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2024, jazzahead! paid special attention to the jazz scene of the Netherlands and invited over forty jazz acts to perform over the course of three days. Among the ensembles presenting themselves at jazzahead! 2024 is trumpeter Christine Kamau’s quartet. Kamau, hailing from Nakuru, Kenya, skillfully blends African rhythms with jazz fusion. She cites Hugh Masekela as her favorite trumpeter, with Roy Hargrove and Miles Davis also serving as significant influences. Using music as a means to promote unity, Kamau has appeared at jazz festivals across Africa, and has been involved in projects with organizations like Pro Helvetia, the British Council, and UNESCO. At jazzahead!, Christine Kamau (trumpet, vocals, synthesizer, keys) appears with Victor Kimetto (keys), Isaac Kimetto (bass), and Richard Wandati (drums).

programme.title: Ed Harcourt, Carl Barât And Peter Doherty - Sgt. Pepper Tribute at Philharmonie de Paris 2017
programme.desc: Celebrated as one of the most influential albums of all times, The Beatles' 1967 Sgt. Pepper’s Lonely Hearts Club Band marked its time and inspired generations of artists. While the album was purely a recording studio product, Beatles’ fans continue to be frustrated by not hearing it live. British musician and composer Ed Harcourt, author of six highly acclaimed albums and collaborator of vocalists Marianne Faithfull, Patti Smith, and trumpeter Erik Truffaz, gathered a supergroup for this occasion with top artists from the British independent rock scene. Join Ed Harcourt and members of The Libertines, Supergrass, The Coral, the Beta Band, and Primal Scream for this special tribute.

programme.title: Marc-André Hamelin - Legato - World of the Piano
programme.desc: We live in a renaissance of the piano”, as the New York Times has recently put it. With virtuosic flair and an eagerness to expand the repertoire, a new generation of pianists has revitalized the instrument’s appeal. In addition to the usual classics, they perform formerly scorned works or discover neglected composers. Legato is a series dedicated to presenting some of this new movement's most fascinating pianists – their individual approaches, their fresh ideas and their music. Each episode portrays an artist and shows an aspect of the world of the piano. The sum of these portraits provides viewers with an overall picture of the art of the pianist. Montréal native Marc-André Hamelin is internationally renowned for his musical virtuosity and refined pianism. The Times described one of his performances as “ultimate perfection”. He plays works by Haydn (Piano sonata in E major), Chopin (Piano sonata No. 3), Debussy (‘Préludes’, book two), Hamelin (Etude No. 7), as well as two short pieces by Gershwin (‘Do, Do, Do’ and ‘Liza’).

programme.title: Kim Zombik And Nicolas Caloia - jazzahead! 2022
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2022, jazzahead! paid special attention to Canada’s jazz scene and invited forty jazz acts from all over the world to perform over the course of three days. Among the performing artists are vocalist Kim Zombik and double bassist Nicolas Caloia. The music of this Montreal-based duo, which goes by the name of Silvervest, is characterized by tenderness, humor and tunefulness. The band’s name pays homage to an item of clothing favored by the indefatigable and endlessly creative legendary drummer Elvin Jones.

programme.title: Jeditah van der Meulen, Brendan Jan Walsh And Jordy Pama - Classical:NEXT 2019 - Jeditah
programme.desc: Jeditah is an experimental songwriter, producer and singer from Amsterdam. She works with Brendan Jan Walsh on cello and Jordy Pama on synths and electronics. From an early age on, Jeditah has been immersed in the world of music, travelling with her parents as a music collective. She finds inspiration in the works of acclaimed artists like Björk, James Blake, Laurie Anderson and PJ Harvey. When she began experimenting with making her own music, she first only utilized her own voice, lowering and altering it, and eventually adding electronic beats and synths. With Electric AlleyCat, Jeditah has established her position as a singer and songwriter. In between performing and recording with the band, she creates layered soundscapes from old recordings and homemade samples. It's here where she develops her very own sound: playful, melancholic and adventurous – music that speaks to the imagination of the listener. In this concert from 2019's Classical:NEXT!, she performs Horseman You And Me, Lay Down, The Night, Differently and Private Space.

programme.title: Arsenik - Arsenik - Olympia, Paris
programme.desc: The mythical duo Arsenik is a rap group from France, made up of two brothers, Lino and Calbo. The team performs at Olympia Paris to celebrate their 20 years since their first album, Quelques gouttes suffisent… It’s a unique concert: Arsenik plays the entire album with numerous special guests for the first time. The album has sold over 300,000 copies in France. Today it’s being considered a classic, and it continues to be cited in the top five of the best French rap albums of all generations. Enjoy Arsenik’s live show in Olympia Paris!

programme.title: Raul Midón - 4K Clips
programme.desc: Stunning 4K clips from the world of pop, rock, jazz, classical music, dance, and theater

programme.title: Fuá Do Guegué - Forró Series
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed and curated in São Paulo by director and presenter Dani Gurgel and producer and engineer Thiago Rabello, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. Curated by its percussionist and leader, Guegué Medeiros, the collective Fuá Do Guegué aims to bring together professionals and artists who identify with and value the rhythms, characteristics, and art of Brazil’s Northeast. With a healthy disregard for preconceived notions and restraints, the collective combines music, film, and dance in their eclectic and highly energetic sets. Fuá Do Guegué consists of Guegué Medeiros (percussion); Salomão Soares (piano); Lau Trajano (bass); Danilo Moraes, Beibe, and Janayna Pereira (percussion and vocals); and Olivio Filho (accordion).

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Memory of a Concert
programme.desc: In 2006, Gidon Kremer and Martha Argerich set out on tour performing solos and duets by Bartók und Schumann. The last of the concert series at the Berliner Philharmonie has been recorded for this film, featuring a rare solo performance by Martha Argerich. A concert film with personal and moving commentary by Gidon Kremer. Program: Schumann's Violin Sonata No. 1, Op. 10, Violin Sonata No. 2, Op. 121; Kinderszenen, Op. 15; Bartók: Violin Sonata No. 1 Sz 75; Violin sonata No. 2 Sz 76.

programme.title: Miles Davis - Episode 3: Miles Davis - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell’Arte in Milan. With tenor saxophonist Wayne Shorter, pianist Herbie Hancock, bassist Ron Carter and drummer Tony Williams, Davis performed Autumn Leaves, My Funny Valentine, All Blues, All of You, and Joshua.

programme.title: Daniel Harding, Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, Coro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino And Christiane Karg - Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna. At the time, Mozart was busy working on his operas La clemenza di Tito and The Magic Flute. By the time he started on the Requiem, in the fall of that same year, his health was seriously declining. Mozart passed away in December 1791, leaving the Requiem uncompleted. His pupil Franz Xaver Süssmayr completed Mozart’s swan song in the form known today, based on Mozart’s sketches and possibly verbal instructions. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Olivier Bogé, Géraldine Laurent, Pierrick Pédron And Thomas de Pourquery - Charlie Parker - Bird with Strings Revisited
programme.desc: In the late 1940s, jazz saxophonist Charlie 'Bird' Parker expressed his wish to record with a classical string section rather than his usual jazz quintet. This desire was fulfilled in 1949 and 1950 when he recorded two albums with oboe, harp, string section and a jazz rhythm section, released as 'Charlie Parker with Strings'. Fast forward 70 years, when saxophonists Olivier Bogé, Géraldine Laurent, Pierrick Pédron, Thomas de Pourquery, and Jaleel Shaw follow in the jazz legend's footsteps, revisiting the repertoire of those original albums in this 2019 concert at The Philharmonie de Paris. Bastien Stil conducts Christophe Dal Sasso's new orchestral arrangements in this genre-blending concert, which opens with Dal Sasso’s very own Overture pour cinq saxophones et orchestra.

programme.title: Misha Mengelberg - Misha Enzovoort
programme.desc: Misha Mengelberg, the forgetting has begun. He is waiting for a taxi he didn’t call to go to a performance that won’t take place. Dutch composer/pianist and grand duke of jazz Misha Mengelberg (1935) has been submerged in the shadow of dementia, ending his life as a musician.

programme.title: Micah McLaurin - PIAM - Semi-final I: Chopin and Scriabin
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano. As part of this competition, Micah McLaurin (USA, 1994) performs Frédéric Chopin’s Nocturne Op. 27 No. 2, and Barcarolle, Op. 60; and a selection of Alexander Scriabin’s Etudes: Op. 42 No. 5, and Op. 8 Nos. 11 and 12. This performance was recorded at Teatro EDI Barrio’s in Milan, in January 2020.

programme.title: Leonardo García Alarcón - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Trio Macaiba - Trio Macaiba - New Year's Eve Special
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is Trio Macaíba, consisting of Beto Corrêa (accordion), Cléber Almeida (zabumba, a type of bass drum), and Ramon Vieira (triangle). Their use of a traditional instrument combination, as well as cultural research, which all members of the group are dedicated to, contributes to the authenticity of the music and their experience as musicians. Enjoy Trio Macaíba in this New Year's Eve special presented by Da Pá Virada Sessions and Stingray!

programme.title: Mario Batkovic - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. The 2018 edition of WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria. One of its showcase participants, Mario Batkovic, aims to explore the sonic possibilities of the accordion, without effects or loops, rather through a mutualist symbiotic relationship between man and instrument. Challenging, hypnotic, and grandiose, Batkovic’s single-handed symphonic vision is certainly unique.

programme.title: Claudio Abbado And Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra - Mozart - Symphony No. 35, K. 385
programme.desc: Claudio Abbado conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Mozart’s “Haffner” Symphony No. 35, K. 385, recorded during the very first Europakonzert in the Smetana Hall in Prague, 1991. Mozart originally composed the symphony as a serenade for the family of Sigmund Haffner, a childhood friend from Salzburg in 1782. The composer made some revisions in the following year, adding multiple instruments and conducted the premiere of the four-movement piece on March 23, 1783, in Vienna. The “Haffner” Symphony, as it is known now, is a transitional work in Mozart’s career. The work was meant to be party music for Salzburg and was transformed into a symphony for Vienna.

programme.title: Anton Schaburov - Mussorgsky - Night on Bald Mountain
programme.desc: Young Euro Classic is the world’s most important platform for international young orchestra musicians in the European classical music tradition, and for its development. For 17 days every summer, orchestras from all over the world perform at Berlin’s Konzerthaus, on Gendarmenmarkt. This performance features some highlights of the Young Euro Classic edition of 2016. On the program are well-known classical pieces, like the third movement of Vivaldi’s “Summer” from Four Seasons, Mussorgky’s “Night on Bald Mountain,” and “Habanera” from Bizet’s Carmen. Tenor Alan Pingarrón sings “Gratia plena,” by Mario Talavera, and “Dime Que Si,” by Alfonso Oteo. On the program are also famous orchestral works like the Adagietto from Mahler’s Symphony No. 5, and the third movement of Rachmaninoff’s Symphony No. 3.

programme.title: Maria Zubimendi, Gorka Catediano And Jon Ansorena - Classical:NEXT 2019 - Trio Zukan
programme.desc: In 2014, Trio Zukan emerged from the combination of three uncommon instruments: accordion, percussion and txistu. The repertoire for this instrumental combination was non-existent at the beginning, so its members decided to promote a project with different composers, with the intention of creating a new repertoire. Today, Zukan has commissioned, revised and released more than a dozen pieces by national and international composers such as: María Eugenia Luc, Mikel Chamizo, Isabel Urrutia, Francisco José Domínguez, Vassilis Filippou, etc. The group is one of the most consolidated groups on the contemporary music scene in the Basque Country. They have performed in Quincena Musical Donostia, Bernaola Festival, Musikagileak Circuit, BBVA Cycle and Attacca Basel, among others. In this concert from the 2019 edition of Classical:NEXT!, Maria Zubimendi (accordion), Gorka Catediano (percussion) and Jon Ansorena (txistu) perform the works X. Otaolea, Gravity, F. Rzewski, as arranged by Trio Zukan, To the Earth, Seis miradas sobre and many more.

programme.title: Fugara - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: George Shearing And Neil Swanson - George Shearing Duo feat. Neil Swainson
programme.desc: British pianist George Shearing enjoyed an international reputation as an instrumentalist, arranger, and composer. Equally at home on the classical concert stage as in jazz clubs, he was recognized for his inventive, orchestrated jazz. In this live recording from the Munich Philharmonie, Shearing played in a duo format with Canadian double bassist Neil Swainson. The repertoire consisted of a selection of compositions by Shearing himself, among them ‘Lullaby Of Birdland’, which is a standard in jazz repertoire.

programme.title: Richie Hawtin - Richie Hawtin at Family Piknik 2017
programme.desc: Born in Britain and raised in Canada, Richie Hawtin is one of the biggest names in today's electro minimal and is one of the instigators of electro house. Hawtin, who rightly calls himself an artist, is always looking for new concepts and ways to push technological boundaries. Let yourself be carried away by the unique and dancing techno rhythms of this innovative DJ with this highly creative set delivered as part of the 2017 edition of the Family Piknik festival.

programme.title: Isabelle Faust - Bach - Partita for Violin No. 2 (BWV 1004)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs two of J. S. Bach’s incredible works for solo violin: Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004), and Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005). Both works are part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Partita No. 2 is made up of four dance movements, concluded by its famous Chaconne, a monumental piece within the violin repertoire. In this Chaconne, Bach develops a series of continuous variations from a theme, exploring a complex range of harmonic possibilities. Sonata No. 3 includes an extensive fugue in which Bach employs many contrapuntal techniques. In this wonderful performance, Faust shows her mastery of Bach’s technically challenging pieces. This performance was recorded at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Germany, in 2020.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong - Louis Armstrong: Live in Australia
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly! He made assorted television appearances, especially in the 1950s and 1960s – the recorded film was a TV Show in Australia when Armstrong was at the peak of his career. Armstrong kept up his busy tour schedule until a few years before his death in 1971. He also toured Africa, Europe, and Asia under sponsorship of the US State Department with great success, earning the nickname ‘Ambassador Satch’.

programme.title: Mario Batkovic - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. The 2018 edition of WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria. One of its showcase participants, Mario Batkovic, aims to explore the sonic possibilities of the accordion, without effects or loops, rather through a mutualist symbiotic relationship between man and instrument. Challenging, hypnotic, and grandiose, Batkovic’s single-handed symphonic vision is certainly unique.

programme.title: Roberto Prosseda, Steven Isserlis And Ian Bostridge - Patmos – A musical documentary
programme.desc: Every summer, the Greek island of Patmos hosts the Patmos Musical Festival, a unique musical event comprising both a Chamber and a Sacred Music Festival. This documentary captures the 2024 edition, featuring performances by distinguished soloists and ensembles from around the world.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen - 4K Clips
programme.desc: Stunning 4K clips from the world of pop, rock, jazz, classical music, dance, and theater

programme.title: UASSYN - jazzahead! 2023 interview
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts. They revive the memory of the festival, the music and the experience.

programme.title: Ivan Gomes And Lucibela Freitas Dos Santos - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria. One of its showcase participants, Lucibela, comes from the island of São Nicolau. Her assured, warm voice is shaped by years of assimilation to the sounds of morna and coladeira.

programme.title: Marnix Busstra - North Sea Jazz Club: Marnix Busstra Band
programme.desc: Guitarist, composer and director Marnix Busstra loves crossing borders. He travels the world with his jazz bands, plays guitar and bouzouki, writes jazz and theatre-songs, and co-creates and directs the exuberant theatre shows of his wife, the Dutch diva Karin Bloemen. Busstra is a constant wheel of invention, with technique expanded by his creative urge to find something new, an evolving state that adds immeasurably to his art. The Marnix Busstra Band was founded in 2011 by its namesake. Joined by piano talent Rembrandt Frerichs, the ever creative double bassist Arnold Dooyeweerd and the inspirational force of drummer Pieter Bast, Busstra introduces a unique band that will definitely help broaden the jazz horizon. Marnix’ compositions are the starting point of the band.
